description: This file defines the Password controller class for the account section of an OpenCart e-commerce system. It manages displaying and processing the password change page, including validation and updating the customer's password.

classes.name: Password
classes.description: Controller class for handling account password change functionality, including displaying the password form and processing updates.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles displaying the password change page, setting up breadcrumbs, and loading view components.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes the password change form submission, validates new password according to configured rules, and updates the customer's password in the database.
